about_the_game:
Within the Shadowed Halls is a first-person survival horror exploring the decaying grandeur of a Bengali Zamindarbari estate. As the manor’s new caretaker, your daylight duties are deceptively simple: clean, repair, and maintain order—while uncovering the strange rules that govern the halls.

But as night falls, the house transforms. Unsettling rituals, shifting rules, and terrifying apparitions turn routine tasks into a desperate fight for survival. Every night brings new secrets, threats, and opportunities to unearth the estate’s haunted past.

Key Features

  • Rules & Rituals: Obey—or defy—a living rulebook to shape your fate. Not all instructions make sense. Breaking the wrong rules has real, terrifying consequences.

  • Caretaker Gameplay: Sweep, repair, and manage the estate by day. Maintain order to delay the house’s descent into supernatural chaos.

  • Dynamic Encounters: Night unleashes hostile entities, shifting halls, and emergent dangers. Adapt or improvise as the rules change.

  • Atmospheric Exploration: A rich, authentic Bengali setting, densely layered with secrets, stories, and spectral dangers.

  • Player Choice: Decide which rules to follow, which rituals to attempt, and how to survive each harrowing night.

Mature Content Warning:
Contains depictions of blood, violence, and unsettling horror imagery.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580 (4 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700K / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 / AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT (8 GB VRAM)

short_description: Survive in a haunted colonial mansion in Bengal. Complete daily chores to keep order by day, then face supernatural anomalies at night. Explore, uncover secrets, and fight for your sanity in this first-person survival horror experience.
